contact.basis: Fixed southwest provider-field datum before floors/mainsections/model geometry. Actual entry threshold and foundation contact remain unverified.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Canonbury House and Canonbury Tower frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.2m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Urban source relief may contain building/canopy artifacts and does not resolve basement floors, entry thresholds, foundations or exact street grades. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
